items.title_en: Half-Baked Product
items.title_zh: 半成品化的产品
items.summary_en: A critique of launching products without proper UX and polish, offering guidance on aligning product scope with real user needs.
items.summary_zh: 该文批评匆忙推出未充分打磨的产品，提出将产品范围与真实用户需求对齐的建议。

items.title_en: Valve open source the Steam Machine e-ink screen so you can make your own
items.title_zh: Valve 将 Steam Machine 的电子墨水屏开源，教你自制
items.summary_en: Valve releases the e-ink display design from Steam Machine as open source, inviting creators to reuse and remix for their own projects. This openness lowers barriers for hardware experimentation and highlights a community driven approach to hardware prototyping.
items.summary_zh: Valve 将 Steam Machine 的电子墨水屏设计开源，鼓励创作者在自定义项目中复用与改造。这一开源举措降低了硬件试验门槛，凸显硬件原型设计的社区驱动性。

items.title_en: Please stop the AI confidence theater
items.title_zh: 请停止 AI 自信表演
items.summary_en: Calls out the phenomenon of AI systems generating overconfident but potentially incorrect results, advocating for calibrated confidence, better UX signals, and rigorous evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 指出 AI 系统产生过度自信但可能错误的现象，倡导校准自信度、改进用户体验信号以及严谨的评估。

items.title_en: Zuckerberg 'Admits' Meta's Layoffs Were Ineffective
items.title_zh: 扎克伯格承认 Meta 的裁员无效
items.summary_en: Coverage of a statement that Meta's layoffs did not achieve the expected outcomes, prompting analysis of cost-cutting versus long-term strategic reinvestment and leadership decisions in big tech.
items.summary_zh: 报道了扎克伯格承认 Meta 的裁员未达到预期效果，并就成本削减与长期战略再投资、以及大型科技公司的领导决策进行了分析。

items.title_en: Alibaba to ban Claude Code in workplace over alleged backdoor risks, source says
items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴拟在工作场所禁用 Claude Code，称存在后门风险
items.summary_en: Alibaba reportedly banned Claude Code in workplace use over alleged backdoor risks, signaling growing caution around enterprise tools. This move could influence how other large employers approach AI coding assistants.
items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴据称因后门风险，在工作场所禁用 Claude Code，凸显企业在 AI 编码工具上的风险管理日益严格。这一举措可能影响其他企业对 AI 编码助手的采用。

items.title_en: Why Switzerland has 25 gbit internet and America doesn't
items.title_zh: 自由市场的谬误：为何瑞士有25 Gbit互联网而美国没有
items.summary_en: The piece argues that Switzerland’s fast, ubiquitous fiber is the result of deliberate public policy, infrastructure sharing, and local competition rather than a laissez-faire telecom market. It contrasts that with structural barriers in the U.S.—incumbent incentives, pole and rights-of-way issues, and regulatory choices—that have kept speeds and deployment lagging despite market rhetoric.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，瑞士的高速光纤来自有意的公共政策、基础设施共享和地方性竞争，而不是放任的自由市场。与之相对，美国因既得利益、线路与通行权问题及监管选择，导致部署和速率长期落后。

items.title_en: Virginia bans sale of precise geolocation data
items.title_zh: 弗吉尼亚州禁止出售地理位置数据
items.summary_en: Virginia's new privacy rule bans the sale of geolocation data collected from devices. The move tightens location data markets and will impact marketers, data brokers, and app developers who rely on location signals. It also heightens regulatory fragmentation as more states consider similar restrictions.
items.summary_zh: 弗吉尼亚州出台隐私新规，禁止出售设备收集的地理位置信息数据。此举收紧了地理位置信息市场，影响依赖位置信号的广告商、数据经纪人与应用开发者。同时，这也可能推动其他州采取类似限制，加剧合规碎片化。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL and the OOM Killer: Why We Use Strict Memory Overcommit
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 与 OOM Killer：为何采用严格的内存超分配
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL deployments rely on strict memory overcommit settings to prevent unpredictable OOM conditions. This approach improves stability in containerized and cloud environments, but can lead to memory inefficiency if not tuned carefully. The piece offers practical guidance for memory budgeting, swap behavior, and kernel parameters to balance safety and performance.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 部署常通过严格的内存超分配设置来避免不可预测的内存不足。该方法在容器化和云环境中提升了稳定性，但若未作充分调优，可能导致内存资源浪费。文中给出内存预算、swap 行为与内核参数等实用建议，帮助在安全和性能之间取得平衡。

items.title_en: CarPlay Is Additive
items.title_zh: CarPlay 是增补而非替代
items.summary_en: The author contends that CarPlay augments existing car interfaces rather than replacing them, adding convenience without solving deeper UX and safety trade-offs in automotive software.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为 CarPlay 是对车载界面的补充，而非替代，带来便利但并未解决汽车软件中的深层 UX 与安全权衡。文章强调苹果的策略改变了用户预期和生态格局，迫使厂商在整合与保留车辆专属控制间寻找平衡。

items.title_en: Wordgard: The new in-browser rich-text editor from the creator of ProseMirror
items.title_zh: WordGard：来自 ProseMirror 创作者的新浏览器端富文本编辑器
items.summary_en: WordGard is a new in-browser rich-text editor by the ProseMirror creator, aiming to streamline building modern editing experiences with collaboration and formatting features. It promises a modular architecture and ergonomic APIs that could accelerate web-based content tools.
items.summary_zh: WordGard 是 ProseMirror 作者推出的全新浏览器端富文本编辑器，旨在简化现代协作与排版功能的编辑体验开发。它承诺模块化架构与易用 API，可能加速网页内容工具的开发。

items.title_en: Hackers shoveled snow for company, were rewarded with network admin access
items.title_zh: 黑客为公司铲雪，结果获得网络管理员权限
items.summary_en: A security anecdote where a social engineering-like scenario leads to privilege escalation after a seemingly harmless act. It underscores the importance of least privilege, robust access controls, and vigilant monitoring to prevent trust abuse.
items.summary_zh: 一起安全事件中，因看似无害的行为而导致特权升级，揭示了最小权限、健全的访问控制以及持续监控以防止信任被滥用的重要性。

items.title_en: Android Developer Verification: Threat masquerading as protection
items.title_zh: Android 开发者验证：伪装成保护的威胁
items.summary_en: Android developer verification can be abused by threat actors who disguise malware as protective or security tools. Such tactics exploit trust signals around security features to mislead users or bypass vetting, undermining platform defenses. The takeaway is a push for tighter vetting, clearer indicators of app behavior, and user skepticism when apps claim to protect you.
items.summary_zh: Android 开发者验证可能被威胁者利用，伪装成保护性工具的恶意软件。此类手段利用安全功能的信任信号误导用户或规避审核，削弱平台防护。要点在于加强审核、提供更清晰的应用行为指示，并提高用户在遇到自称保护工具的应用时的警惕。

items.title_en: Right to Local Intelligence
items.title_zh: 本地智能权利
items.summary_en: This initiative advocates for users' ability to run and control AI locally, insisting on data sovereignty, local execution, and limits on remote-only models. It frames local intelligence as a civil-rights-style principle to protect privacy, reduce centralized surveillance, and preserve user agency over AI-driven decisions.
items.summary_zh: 该倡议主张用户应有在本地运行并控制 AI 的权利，强调数据主权、本地执行并限制仅能远程运算的模型。它把本地智能视为类似公民权利的原则，用以保护隐私、降低集中化监控并维护用户对 AI 决策的掌控。

items.title_en: Gemini Code Assist will be shut down on July 17
items.title_zh: Gemini Code Assist 将于 7 月 17 日关闭
items.summary_en: Announcement that Gemini Code Assist will shut down on July 17, requiring users to migrate to alternative coding tools. Reflects the volatility of AI-assisted coding products and encourages teams to plan tooling strategy with vendor changes in mind.
items.summary_zh: 宣布 Gemini Code Assist 将在 7 月 17 日关闭，用户需迁移到其他编码工具。体现了 AI 辅助编码产品的波动性，建议团队在工具策略中考虑厂商变动。

items.title_en: An American Privacy Emergency
items.title_zh: 美国的隐私紧急状态
items.summary_en: The essay warns that current U.S. laws and enforcement are failing to contain pervasive data collection and surveillance, arguing for urgent legislative and regulatory reforms. It emphasizes that without stronger privacy protections and accountability, harms from misuse of personal data will keep accelerating across commercial and governmental actors.
items.summary_zh: 文中警告美国现有法律和执法未能遏制无处不在的数据收集与监控，呼吁紧急的立法与监管改革。文章强调若无更强的隐私保护与问责机制，个人数据滥用带来的伤害将在商业与政府层面持续加剧。

items.title_en: The Fall and Rise of Screwworm
items.title_zh: 螺旋蠅的兴衰
items.summary_en: A historical look at the螺螺蠅 pest and how control methods evolved, highlighting large-scale interventions like sterile insect techniques and integrated pest management as technology and policy matured jointly.
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾螺螺蠅害的发展与控制方法的演进，强调在技术与政策共同进步下，大规模灭蝇放射性昆虫等干预以及综合虫害管理的重要性。

items.title_en: Spain Orders Blacklist of Palantir from Public and Private Companies
items.title_zh: 西班牙将 Palantir 列入公私部门黑名单
items.summary_en: Spain Orders Blacklist of Palantir from Public and Private Companies
items.summary_zh: 西班牙对 Palantir 的公私部门使用实施黑名单，反映对数据隐私与监控技术的监管关注。

items.title_en: AI Data Centers Use More Water Than Most Tech Giants Report
items.title_zh: AI 数据中心用水量高于多数科技巨头披露的水平
items.summary_en: Analyzes water usage in AI data centers, arguing that actual consumption may exceed what is publicly disclosed by many tech giants. The piece calls for improved reporting, more efficient cooling, and policy considerations as AI workloads scale.
items.summary_zh: 分析 AI 数据中心的用水情况，认为实际水耗可能高于多家科技巨头公开披露的水平。呼吁改进披露、提升冷却效率，并就随着 AI 工作负载扩张的政策进行考量。

items.title_en: crustc: entirety of `rustc`, translated to C
items.title_zh: crustc：将整个 rustc 翻译为 C
items.summary_en: crustc is an ambitious project that translates the entirety of the Rust compiler into C, aiming to make rustc more portable and easier to bootstrap on unusual toolchains. The repo is experimental but useful as a study in compiler architecture, portability trade-offs, and alternate bootstrapping strategies.
items.summary_zh: crustc 是个雄心勃勃的工程，把整个 Rust 编译器翻译成 C，目标是提升 rustc 在非常规工具链上的可移植性和引导能力。该项目处于实验性阶段，但对研究编译器架构、可移植性权衡以及替代引导策略很有价值。

items.title_en: Jamesob's guide to running SOTA LLMs locally
items.title_zh: Jamesob 的本地运行 SOTA 大语言模型指南
items.summary_en: A practical guide to running state of the art LLMs on local hardware. It covers model selection, quantization, offloading, and tooling to optimize memory and compute, enabling researchers to prototype without cloud dependence while noting tradeoffs in accuracy and resource use.
items.summary_zh: 这是一份在本地硬件上运行 SOTA 大语言模型的实用指南，涵盖模型选择、量化、离载与工具链等方面的内存和算力优化。帮助研究者在不依赖云端的情况下进行原型开发，同时指明精度与资源成本之间的取舍。

items.title_en: Podman v6.0.0
items.title_zh: Podman 6.0.0 版本发布
items.summary_en: Podman 6.0.0 marks a major milestone with expanded rootless container support, improved OCI compatibility, and streamlined tooling. It emphasizes security and developer ergonomics, aligning Podman with modern container workloads and Kubernetes workflows.
items.summary_zh: 6.0.0 版本标志着 Podman 的一个重要里程碑，增强了无根容器支持、改进的 OCI 兼容性以及更简化的工具链。此版本强调安全性与开发者体验，使 Podman 更适合现代容器工作负载和 Kubernetes 场景。

items.title_en: Since Linux 6.9, LUKS suspend stopped wiping disk-encryption keys from memory
items.title_zh: 自 Linux 6.9 起，LUKS 休眠不再从内存擦除磁盘加密密钥
items.summary_en: Linux 6.9 introduced a change where LUKS suspend no longer clears in-memory keys, trading security for faster resume. The decision highlights the ongoing tension between safeguarding encryption keys and preserving usability in sleep states.
items.summary_zh: 自 Linux 6.9 起，LUKS 休眠不再从内存中清除磁盘加密密钥，提升恢复速度的同时扩大了内存中密钥暴露的风险。这一取舍凸显了在安全性与可用性之间的持续权衡。

items.title_en: Immich 3.0
items.title_zh: Immich 3.0 版本发布
items.summary_en: Immich 3.0 ships major improvements to the open-source self-hosted photo backup app, including a refreshed UI, faster sync, and stronger privacy controls.
items.summary_zh: Immich 3.0 为开源自托管照片备份应用带来重大改进，包括焕然一新的界面、更快的同步速度以及更强的隐私控制。

items.title_en: PeerTube is a free, decentralized and federated video platform
items.title_zh: PeerTube 是一个免费、去中心化且联邦化的视频平台
items.summary_en: PeerTube is a free, decentralized and federated video platform
items.summary_zh: PeerTube 提供一个免费、去中心化且联邦化的视频平台，强调社区主机与隐私保护，体现对大型中心化平台的替代愿景。

items.title_en: The Safari MCP server for web developers
items.title_zh: 面向网页开发者的 Safari MCP 服务器
items.summary_en: A new Safari MCP server provides web developers with a local, developer-facing environment for testing and debugging.
items.summary_zh: 新推出的 Safari MCP 服务器为网页开发者提供本地化的测试和调试环境。

items.title_en: Exapunks (2018)
items.title_zh: Exapunks（2018）
items.summary_en: Exapunks is a 2018 puzzle game from Zachtronics that tasks players with coding-like instructions to hack into systems. Its meticulous, systems-thinking puzzles made it a cult classic among players who enjoy programming challenges and cyberpunk lore.
items.summary_zh: Exapunks 是 Zachtronics 于2018年推出的一款以编码风格指令来入侵系统的解谜游戏。其严谨的系统思维难题和赛博朋克氛围让它在喜欢编程挑战的玩家中成为小众经典。

items.title_en: AI coding is addictive. Engineers are paying the price
items.title_zh: AI 编码成瘾，工程师正付出代价
items.summary_en: Examines how AI assisted coding can become addictive and erode deep work skills, increasing cognitive load and risk of burnout. Proposes guardrails, balanced usage, and sustainable practices for teams.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 辅助编码可能导致成瘾、侵蚀深度工作能力，增加认知负荷与倦怠风险。提出设定边界、平衡使用和可持续的团队实践。

items.title_en: Best Simple System for Now
items.title_zh: 现阶段的最佳简单系统
items.summary_en: A pragmatic take on building a dependable stack by prioritizing simplicity over clever optimizations. The piece emphasizes clear defaults, minimal dependencies, and observable behavior, with guidance on when more complexity is warranted as needs grow.
items.summary_zh: 以务实视角主张以简单为首要原则来打造可靠的技术栈，优先清晰默认、最小化依赖与可观察性，并在需求扩大时再引入更复杂的方案。

items.title_en: AI can't be listed as inventor on patent applications, Japan's top court rules
items.title_zh: 日本最高法院裁定 AI 不能作为发明人列入专利申请
items.summary_en: Japan's top court rules AI can't be listed as inventor on patent applications. That means humans must be named as inventors, keeping a clear line between human ingenuity and AI contributions with implications for IP governance.
items.summary_zh: 日本最高法院裁定 AI 不能作为发明人出现在专利申请中，意味着发明人必须是人类。这对 AI 辅助的发明及未来的知识产权治理有现实影响。

items.title_en: How Fighter Jets Lock on (and How the Targets Know) (2014)
items.title_zh: 战斗机如何锁定目标，以及目标如何知晓（2014）
items.summary_en: A 2014 explainer on how fighter jets lock onto targets using sensors and radar, and what countermeasures reveal about the target's awareness. The piece offers a lens on sensor fusion, autonomy, and the limits of stealth.
items.summary_zh: 一篇 2014 年的科普文章，讲解战斗机如何通过传感器与雷达锁定目标，以及对手对抗手段所揭示的知情范围。为传感器融合、自主性与隐身极限提供了视角。

items.title_en: Commodore 64 Basic for PostgreSQL
items.title_zh: Commodore 64 BASIC 与 PostgreSQL
items.summary_en: A playful exploration of bridging retro Commodore 64 BASIC with modern database concepts, illustrating how far tooling has advanced and offering lessons on API design and resource constraints from the past to inform today’s design.
items.summary_zh: 对将 Commodore 64 的 BASIC 与现代数据库概念相连接的趣味探索，展示了工具的发展之远，并从过去的资源约束和 API 设计中提取对当下设计的经验教训。

items.title_en: Postgres transactions are a distributed systems superpower
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 事务是分布式系统的超级能力
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL transactions enable strong consistency across distributed workflows by co-locating state with data, reducing cross-service coordination and failure modes. This approach can simplify building reliable, scalable systems with complex data interactions.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 的事务模型让在分布式工作流中实现强一致性成为可能，通过将工作流状态与数据并置，降低跨服务协调的复杂度。此做法有助于构建在数据交互复杂的场景下更可靠、可扩展的系统。

items.title_en: Markets are competitive if and only if P = NP
items.title_zh: 市场只有在 P=NP 时才具备竞争性
items.summary_en: A provocative theoretical claim tying market competitiveness to a core question in computer science. If P equals NP, computing equilibria or optimal strategies becomes tractable, potentially enabling highly competitive markets; if not, some optimal outcomes remain intractable, dampening competition and innovation.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇把市场竞争性与计算复杂性中的核心问题联系起来的理论性主张。若 P=NP，求解均衡和最优策略将变得可行，理论上可能促成高度竞争的市场；若 P≠NP，一些最优结果将难以计算，可能抑制竞争与创新。

items.title_en: Give Smart People the Tools to Do Smart Things
items.title_zh: 给聪明的人工具，让他们做更聪明的事
items.summary_en: Argues for equipping talented engineers with powerful, well designed tools to unleash impactful work.
items.summary_zh: 主张为才干出众的工程师提供强大且设计良好的工具，以释放具有影响力的工作。讨论搭建内部工具的模式、降低认知负荷、让团队在创新中胜于与繁琐流程对抗。

items.title_en: The short leash AI coding method for beating Fable
items.title_zh: 短绳 AI 编程法：战胜 Fable
items.summary_en: The Short Leash AI Coding Method advocates disciplined, constrained prompts and incremental validation to keep AI-assisted coding reliable and controllable.
items.summary_zh: 短绳 AI 编程法提倡在 AI 辅助编码中使用受控、受限的提示以及逐步验证来保持产出可控性和可靠性。

items.title_en: Faster embeddings: how we rebuilt the ONNX path in Manticore
items.title_zh: 14倍更快的嵌入：我们在 Manticore 中重构 ONNX 路径
items.summary_en: Manticore redesigned its ONNX embedding path to achieve roughly 14x faster embeddings, dramatically speeding up vector-based search workloads. The post explains the engineering choices that unlocked this uplift and its practical impact on real-time AI tasks.
items.summary_zh: Manticore 重新设计了 ONNX 嵌入路径，使嵌入速度提升约 14 倍，显著加速向量搜索工作负载。文章阐述实现这一提升的工程选择及对实时 AI 任务的实际影响。

items.title_en: Claude-real-video － any LLM can watch a video
items.title_zh: Claude-real-video：让任意大模型能看视频
items.summary_en: Claude-real-video demonstrates a method for any language model to watch and interpret video content, pushing toward more capable multimodal AI.
items.summary_zh: Claude-real-video 展示了让任意语言模型观看并理解视频内容的方法，推动多模态人工智能的进步。

items.title_en: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions
items.title_zh: 程序即权重：模糊函数的编程范式
items.summary_en: Introduces a programming paradigm where programs carry weights to handle fuzziness and uncertainty, linking ideas from probabilistic and differentiable programming to support robust approximate computation.
items.summary_zh: 提出一种将程序视作带权重的组件以处理模糊性与不确定性的编程范式，连接概率编程与可微分编程的思路，支持对近似计算的鲁棒性设计。

items.title_en: EFF letter to FTC on X consent order [pdf]
items.title_zh: 电子前线基金会致 FTC 关于 X 同意令的信
items.summary_en: The EFF and allied groups asked the FTC to deny a petition to waive parts of a privacy-related consent order, arguing the platform has not satisfied its obligations and that public privacy risks remain. The letter calls for sustained enforcement and transparency rather than early relief for the company.
items.summary_zh: 电子前线基金会及其盟友请求 FTC 拒绝一项豁免隐私相关同意令的申请，认为该平台并未履行义务且公众隐私风险依然存在。信中主张应继续加强执法与透明度，而非提前给予公司宽免。

items.title_en: Mystery identity of 'Green Boots' climber is finally solved after DNA test
items.title_zh: “绿靴子”登山者身份终于通过 DNA 检测揭晓
items.summary_en: A decades-old Everest mystery has been resolved: DNA testing has identified the climber known as 'Green Boots', whose body was long used as an on-route landmark. The identification closes a long-standing question while reopening ethical debates about bodies on high-altitude routes and memorialization.
items.summary_zh: 几十年的珠峰谜案有了结果：通过 DNA 鉴定确认了被称为“绿靴子”的登山者身份，这具尸体长期被用作路线地标。身份确认结束了悬而未决的问题，但也再次引发了关于高海拔遗体处置与纪念方式的伦理讨论。

items.title_en: The fall of the theorem economy
items.title_zh: 定理经济的衰落
items.summary_en: The piece argues that the so-called theorem economy, which prioritizes formal proofs and guarantees, may be losing its primacy in tech and science. It advocates pragmatic engineering, testing, and real-world outcomes over pursuit of perfect formal guarantees.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为以形式化证明和保证为核心的“定理经济”可能正在失去主导地位。倡导务实的工程实践、测试与实际结果，避免过度追求完美的形式化保证。

items.title_en: Great Salt Lake Tracker
items.title_zh: 大盐湖追踪器：Grow the Flow
items.summary_en: Great Salt Lake Tracker, part of Grow the Flow, collects lake-level observations to monitor hydrological changes and climate impacts. It demonstrates how citizen science and local data can inform water management decisions.
items.summary_zh: Great Salt Lake Tracker 是 Grow the Flow 计划的一部分，收集大盐湖水位等观测数据，监测水文变化与气候影响。该项目展示了公民科学与本地数据在水资源管理中的应用潜力。

items.title_en: This is my attempt to get Vulkan going on NetBSD
items.title_zh: 这是我让 Vulkan 在 NetBSD 上运行的尝试
items.summary_en: This is my attempt to get Vulkan going on NetBSD
items.summary_zh: 作者分享在 NetBSD 上让 Vulkan 运行的尝试，展示了 BSD 系统上现代图形栈的进展与仍存的挑战。

items.title_en: 24-bit/192kHz music downloads and why they make no sense (2012)
items.title_zh: 24 位/192kHz 音乐下载为何没有意义（2012）
items.summary_en: The 24-bit/192kHz claim often fails to justify its file size given perceptual limits and encoding realities that favor more efficient choices.
items.summary_zh: 文章论述为何 24 位/192kHz 的音乐下载在实际听感和编码成本上并无意义，强调更务实的音质选择。

items.title_en: Anatomy of Persistent Memory's 3 Layers: Comparing ContextNest, Mem0 and Zep
items.title_zh: 持久内存的三层结构解析：ContextNest、Mem0 与 Zep 比较
items.summary_en: A comparative look at three persistent-memory abstractions ContextNest, Mem0, and Zep, covering data models, consistency guarantees, and use cases for fast durable access. Helps developers choose the right layer for workloads.
items.summary_zh: 对持久内存三大抽象层 ContextNest、Mem0 与 Zep 进行对比，介绍它们的数据模型、一致性保证及在需要快速耐久访问的工作负载中的适用场景，帮助开发者选择合适的层级。

items.title_en: Lightning Memory-Mapped Database Manager (LMDB) 1.0
items.title_zh: LMDB 1.0：Lightning 内存映射数据库
items.summary_en: LMDB 1.0 marks a milestone for the Lightning Memory-Mapped Database, a compact, ultra-fast key-value store that uses memory-mapped I/O and supports ACID transactions. The release emphasizes stability and high performance for read-heavy workloads and embedded use.
items.summary_zh: LMDB 1.0 标志着 Lightning 内存映射数据库的一个里程碑，这是一款紧凑且极快的键值存储，使用内存映射 I/O 并支持 ACID 事务。该版本强调在读密集型工作负载和嵌入式场景中的稳定性与高性能。

items.title_en: NSA tries to weaken mlkem standardisation?
items.title_zh: NSA 企图削弱 MLKEM 标准化进程
items.summary_en: NSA tries to weaken mlkem standardisation
items.summary_zh: 据称国家安全局试图削弱 ML-KEM 等标准化进程，引发关于开放标准与国家安全之间的辩论。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Manufact (YC S25) – MCP Cloud
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Manufact（YC S25）—— MCP Cloud
items.summary_en: Manufact, a YC S25 startup, unveils MCP Cloud, a cloud-based platform to run manufacturing control workflows. The move signals a shift toward cloud-native tooling in hardware, aiming to simplify configuration and scaling of production lines.
items.summary_zh: Manufact，一家 YC S25 支持的制造业初创，推出 MCP Cloud，将云端用于运行制造控制工作流，意在简化配置和扩展生产线。此举体现了硬件领域对云原生工具的日益依赖。

items.title_en: FoundationDB's Flow – Bringing Actor-Based Concurrency to C++11
items.title_zh: FoundationDB 的 Flow：将基于 Actor 的并发带到 C++11
items.summary_en: Flow is an actor-style concurrency framework used in FoundationDB that implements lightweight actors and cooperative scheduling in portable C++11. It provides a model for writing highly concurrent database internals without relying on OS threads per actor, enabling scalable, deterministic task interleaving inside a C++ codebase.
items.summary_zh: Flow 是 FoundationDB 使用的基于 actor 的并发框架，在可移植的 C++11 中实现了轻量级 actor 和协作调度。它为在 C++ 代码库中编写高并发数据库内部逻辑提供了模型，无需为每个 actor 使用操作系统线程，从而实现可扩展且更可预测的任务交错。

items.title_en: JEP 539: Strict Field Initialization in the JVM moved to preview
items.title_zh: JEP 539：JVM 的严格字段初始化移到预览阶段
items.summary_en: JEP 539 moves Strict Field Initialization to preview in the JVM, letting developers opt in to stricter initialization checks ahead of full adoption.
items.summary_zh: JEP 539 将 JVM 的严格字段初始化移至预览阶段，允许开发者先行体验更严格的初始化检查，以备未来全面采纳。

items.title_en: Show HN: TaskPeace – a task queue my AI coding agents pull work from over MCP
items.title_zh: Show HN：TaskPeace——一个 AI 编码代理从 MCP 拉取任务的任务队列
items.summary_en: Show HN featuring TaskPeace, a task queue used by AI coding agents to pull work from a central MCP. The system emphasizes low-latency task dispatch, simple API, and scalable coordination for autonomous agents.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示 TaskPeace，这是一个供 AI 编码代理从 MCP 拉取任务的任务队列。系统强调低延迟派发、简洁 API 设计以及对自治代理的可扩展协调能力。

items.title_en: Is the iPhone birth control? Causal evidence from AT&T's 2007-2011 monopoly [pdf]
items.title_zh: iPhone 是生育控制工具吗？来自 AT&T 2007–2011 垄断期的因果证据
items.summary_en: The paper exploits geographic and temporal variation from AT&T’s exclusive iPhone distribution between 2007–2011 to estimate how differential early access to smartphones affected fertility. Using that natural experiment, it presents causal evidence that iPhone availability changed birth rates for certain populations, suggesting technology adoption can have measurable demographic effects.
items.summary_zh: 论文利用 AT&T 在 2007–2011 年对 iPhone 的独家分销造成的时空差异，来估计早期智能手机接入对生育率的影响。通过这一定然实验，研究提供了 iPhone 可用性改变特定人群出生率的因果证据，表明技术采纳会对人口统计产生可测量的影响。

items.title_en: OpenUI: Open Standard for Generative UI
items.title_zh: OpenUI：生成式用户界面的开放标准
items.summary_en: OpenUI proposes an open standard for generative user interfaces, aiming to standardize prompts, components, and behavior across tools.
items.summary_zh: OpenUI 提出面向生成式用户界面的开放标准，旨在规范跨工具的提示、组件和行为。

items.title_en: Show HN: zkGolf – Competitive optimization of formally verified circuits
items.title_zh: Show HN: zkGolf——对形式化验证电路的竞争性优化
items.summary_en: zkGolf explores competitive optimization of formally verified circuits using zero-knowledge proofs, aiming to accelerate search without sacrificing verifiability.
items.summary_zh: zkGolf 以零知识证明为手段，对形式化验证的电路进行竞争性优化，力求在不牺牲可验证性的前提下提升搜索效率。

items.title_en: Show HN: Inkwell – An RSS reader for e-ink devices
items.title_zh: 展示 HN：Inkwell——为电子墨水设备设计的 RSS 阅读器
items.summary_en: Inkwell is an RSS reader optimized for e-ink devices, focusing on low-power refresh, offline caching, and readable formatting tailored to slow-refresh displays. It targets Kindles and similar hardware, making it easier to consume long-form text without web bloat or heavy JavaScript.
items.summary_zh: Inkwell 是为电子墨水屏设备优化的 RSS 阅读器，注重低功耗刷新、离线缓存和为慢刷新屏做的易读排版。它面向 Kindle 等设备，让用户在没有网页臃肿和大量 JavaScript 的情况下更便捷地阅读长篇内容。

items.title_en: FBI Seizes NetNut Proxy Platform, Popa Botnet
items.title_zh: FBI 查封 NetNut 代理平台及 Popa 僵尸网络
items.summary_en: The FBI seized NetNut Proxy Platform and the Popa botnet, in a crackdown on cybercrime infrastructure and proxy networks; a reminder of law enforcement pressure on illicit online services.
items.summary_zh: FBI 对 NetNut 代理平台及 Popa 僵尸网络采取行动，打击网络犯罪基础设施，凸显执法对非法在线服务的打压。

items.title_en: Amazon's Mechanical Turk to stop accepting new customers
items.title_zh: 亚马逊的 Mechanical Turk 将停止接受新用户注册
items.summary_en: Amazon's Mechanical Turk is halting new customer signups, signaling strategic shifts for the longstanding crowdsourcing marketplace and potential implications for customers and workers.
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊的 Mechanical Turk 将停止接受新用户注册，表明其在长期众包市场中的策略转变，并影响用户和工作者。

items.title_en: LibreCAD in the Browser
items.title_zh: 浏览器中的 LibreCAD
items.summary_en: LibreCAD now runs in the browser via WebAssembly, enabling instant CAD work without desktop installs. This reflects the broader move of CAD and design tools to the web.
items.summary_zh: LibreCAD 现已通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行，使用户无需桌面安装即可进行 CAD 工作，体现了 CAD/设计工具向 Web 的迁移趋势。

items.title_en: Superpowers 6
items.title_zh: Superpowers 6 版本发布
items.summary_en: Superpowers 6 introduces new features in the Superpowers toolkit, focusing on improved developer ergonomics, tooling, and performance.
items.summary_zh: Superpowers 6 在现有工具包中增加新特性，提升开发者体验、工具链和性能。

items.title_en: Reality has a surprising amount of detail (2017)
items.title_zh: 现实中隐藏着出人意料的细节（2017）
items.summary_en: Reality has a surprising amount of detail
items.summary_zh: 现实包含的细节远超简单模型所能覆盖，挑战了我们对世界需要描述多少的假设。

items.title_en: Show HN: Pieces – Social network for people
items.title_zh: 展示 HN：Pieces——以人为本的社交网络
items.summary_en: Pieces bills itself as a social network that prioritizes real people and meaningful connections over algorithmic feeds, focusing on privacy and user control. It aims to offer a simpler, less attention-harvesting alternative for those frustrated with mainstream platforms’ dynamics.
items.summary_zh: Pieces 标榜为优先考虑真实人与有意义连接的社交网络，强调隐私与用户控制而非算法驱动的信息流。它为对主流平台机制感到厌烦的用户提供了更简洁、非吸引注意力的替代选项。

items.title_en: German button maker searched rivers of American Midwest for valuable shells
items.title_zh: 德国钮扣制造商在美国中西部河流寻找珍贵贝壳
items.summary_en: German button maker searched rivers of American Midwest for valuable shells
items.summary_zh: 一位德国钮扣制造商在美国中西部河流寻找用于钮扣的珍贵贝壳，揭示了19世纪全球贸易网络与材料来源对制造业的影响。

items.title_en: Underwater suit-wearing cyborg insect capable of diving and terra-aqua travel
items.title_zh: 穿着水下套装的昆虫仿生体，能够潜水并实现陆海穿梭
items.summary_en: Nature Communications reports a biohybrid insect wearing a functional underwater suit capable of diving, plus terra-aqua travel, demonstrating advances in autonomous bio-inspired robotics. This could enable new capabilities in environmental monitoring and search tasks.
items.summary_zh: Nature 通讯报道，一种佩戴水下套装的昆虫仿生体能够潜水，并实现陆海穿梭，展示了仿生机器人领域的进展。这类技术或将用于环境监测、搜索等任务。

items.title_en: How working with a blind client revealed invisible accessibility gaps
items.title_zh: 与盲人客户合作揭示的隐形无障碍差距
items.summary_en: Working with a blind client exposed blind spots in accessibility assumptions, underscoring the value of inclusive testing early in the product cycle.
items.summary_zh: 与盲人客户合作暴露了对无障碍的盲点，强调在产品开发早期进行包容性测试的价值。文中给出针对无障碍软件的实际教训，帮助团队改进屏幕阅读器和键盘导航等方面。

items.title_en: Apricot Computers: An underrated British brand
items.title_zh: 被低估的英国品牌 Apricot Computers
items.summary_en: Apricot Computers—a once-respected UK PC maker—gets a retrospective look, highlighting its innovations and why it remains underrated in computing history.
items.summary_zh: 对英国老牌电脑厂商 Apricot Computers 的回顾，突出其创新之处以及为何在计算机史上被低估。

items.title_en: Quake in 13 Kilobytes (2021)
items.title_zh: 13 千字节的 Quake（2021）
items.summary_en: A 13KB Quake entry from the JS13K competition that demonstrates maximal functionality in extreme size limits, illustrating compact coding tricks and creative optimization.
items.summary_zh: 在 JS13K 比赛中，用仅 13KB 构成的 Quake 展示了在极小尺寸下实现完整功能的能力，体现紧凑编码与创意优化。

items.title_en: Hunting a 16-year-old SQLite WAL bug with TLA+
items.title_zh: 用 TLA+ 发现 SQLite WAL 的 16 年旧漏洞
items.summary_en: A case study showing how formal methods helped uncover a longstanding SQLite WAL bug. By modeling the write ahead log with TLA+, the team reasoned about correctness and edge cases beyond conventional testing, underscoring the value of formal verification in database engines.
items.summary_zh: 一个案例研究，展示通过形式化方法用 TLA+ 对 SQLite 的写前日志进行建模，揭示长期存在的漏洞并对正确性和边界情况进行了推理，凸显形式化验证在数据库引擎中的重要性。

items.title_en: Perform DFU Restores on Apple Silicon Macs with Macvdmtool (2021)
items.title_zh: 在 Apple Silicon 的 Mac 上用 Macvdmtool 进行 DFU 恢复（2021）
items.summary_en: A guide or note on performing DFU restores on Apple Silicon Macs using Macvdmtool, covering steps and caveats for recovery tasks.
items.summary_zh: 介绍在 Apple Silicon 的 Mac 上使用 Macvdmtool 进行 DFU 恢复的方法，包含实现步骤与注意事项。

items.title_en: Local Reasoning for Global Properties
items.title_zh: 局部推理与全局性质
items.summary_en: Explores how local reasoning can establish global properties, with implications for software verification, distributed systems, and modular proof techniques.
items.summary_zh: 探讨如何通过局部推理来确立全局性质，对软件验证、分布式系统与模块化证明技术具有影响。提出将局部证明拼接成全局保证的策略。

items.title_en: Q&A with Micron's VP and GM of Memory
items.title_zh: 与 Micron 的存储部副总裁兼总经理的问答
items.summary_en: Q&A with Micron's VP and GM of Memory covering memory technology trends, such as DRAM and NAND, persistence, and upcoming innovations, with implications for hardware design and data center economics.
items.summary_zh: 采访美光存储部副总裁兼总经理，讨论内存技术趋势、DRAM/NAND、持久性等，并探讨对硬件设计和数据中心经济性的影响。

items.title_en: The Beauty of Tautologies
items.title_zh: 恒真性的美
items.summary_en: Celebrates tautologies for their elegant simplicity and structural clarity, illustrating how self-evident truths illuminate proofs, logic, and even code design.
items.summary_zh: 赞美恒真性在逻辑和证明中的简洁性与结构清晰，展示自明之理如何照亮证明、逻辑甚至代码设计的思路。

items.title_en: A Special Wireless-Free Nikon Camera Is Publicly Available for the First Time
items.title_zh: 一款特别的无无线尼康相机首次公开发售
items.summary_en: A Nikon model stripped of wireless radios—intended for secure, wire-free environments—has become publicly available for the first time. That makes a niche product aimed at privacy-minded or security-conscious users accessible beyond government and corporate procurement channels.
items.summary_zh: 一款去除了无线模块、适用于安全无线环境的尼康机型首次对公众发售。该小众产品将原本面向政府与企业采购的隐私/安全导向相机带入了普通用户市场。

items.title_en: Cowboys, Frontiersmen, Settlers, Townspeople, Cityfolk
items.title_zh: 牛仔、拓荒者、殖民者、镇民、城民
items.summary_en: A reflective piece about company life-cycle phases framed as archetypes—Cowboys, Frontiersmen, Settlers, Townspeople, and Cityfolk—to illustrate how teams evolve as products scale.
items.summary_zh: 本文将公司生命周期阶段比喻为牛仔、拓荒者、殖民者、镇民和城民，揭示团队在产品扩展过程中的演变。

items.title_en: Show HN: OM Core – multidimensional models without spreadsheet cell formulas
items.title_zh: Show HN：OM Core——无须电子表格单元格公式的多维模型
items.summary_en: Show HN presenting OM Core, a tool for building multidimensional models without spreadsheet cell formulas. It aims to streamline analytics modeling with code or declarative specifications, improving scalability and maintainability.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 介绍 OM Core，这是一种无需电子表格单元格公式的多维模型构建工具，旨在通过代码或声明性规范简化分析建模，提升可扩展性和可维护性。
